decision_summary: Implement v0.6.31 as a standalone Calibration Report package composed from existing quality-gate decisions and outcomes.
rationale: Visionary: calibration closes the gap between stated confidence and observed results. Builder: a separate package preserves existing gate semantics and enables deterministic arithmetic. Guardian: example or synthetic data, insufficient samples, and evaluation limitations must remain explicit, governance-routed, and unable to produce an automatic quality verdict.
recommendation: Implement schema, verifier, calculation tool, example, negative fixtures, CLI integration, plain-language docs, roadmap update, and release evidence.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, reviewers, and governance owners
expected_user_reaction: Users can inspect exactly how confidence alignment was calculated and why a report remains provisional.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add calibration-report as a composable package type rather than expanding quality-gate ownership.
